title: USTM student strike and march over university closure and resumption of classes
location: USTM main entrance, Franceville, Haut-Ogooué Province
organizer: USTM students; specific organizing committee unknown
threshold_50_evidence: No count or explicitly sufficient qualitative size description. The report says students plural and describes a march/barricade but does not support >=50.

start_date.summary: Report says strike began 2 Nov, published 3 Nov.

location.summary: USTM at Franceville in Haut-Ogooué; students barricaded the main entrance.

demands.summary: Students called for return to classes and government clarification about delayed academic activity/teachers' strike.

participants.summary: Students collectively marched with chants/song/dance; number absent.

notes: This is a public campus-gate action and not only a private dispute; target reported as government clarification. Keep episode continuity provisional.
open_questions: Can an admissible report quantify the Nov2 gathering or give a clearly sufficient threshold estimate?
Did activity continue after Nov3/Nov4, and did it remain the same episode?
Were other actions elsewhere in November related or distinct?
